I read the whole file, lines 1–276, from the supplied source. I did not search Mathlib or other sources for lemmas that might replace parts of it, and I did not check whether any other file in TauCeti repeats this machinery.

The only long proof is `norm_radialRetraction_sub_le`. Its two far-point branches use different arguments. In the first branch, one point is fixed and the other moves by `‖x‖ - r`. In the second, both points are pushed to the sphere and compared through a cone estimate. Their shared `hxy` step is a one-line calculation, so a helper would not pay for itself.

The case splits on `‖x‖ = 0` in `radialRetraction_of_norm_le` and `radialRetraction_of_le_norm` are short and each handles different algebra. The centred versions and the `LipschitzOnWith`, `HolderOnWith` and `HolderWith` composition lemmas already reuse the base lemmas. They are thin wrappers around existing API such as `hf.comp` and `comp_holderWith`, which the rubric excludes. I found no nontrivial reasoning duplicated across two or more proofs, so I report no finding.
